abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
abilities.flavor_text: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

abilities.name: Super Luck
abilities.effect: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.
abilities.flavor_text: When the Pokémon is hit by a Dark-type attack, its Attack stat is boosted by its sense of justice.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.effect: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
abilities.flavor_text: Cures the Pokémon's status conditions in rain.

abilities.name: Sticky Hold
abilities.effect: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

abilities.name: Stance Change
abilities.effect: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.
